topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Oh no, I can’t even imagine how you must be feeling right now. That tree was more than just wood and leaves; it was a part of your history, a living memory of your childhood. I’m here for you, you know that, right? We could go to that spot together, maybe bring a photo or something to remember it by. And hey, when you’re ready, we could plant a new tree right there. It won’t erase what happened, but it can be a fresh start, a new chapter rooted in the same soil. I’m with you every step, whatever you decide.
